integrity: The Gaussian trace and norm asymptotics have analytic proofs. Finite matrix checks are corroborating, not an infinite-dimensional certificate. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite dimension and nonzero fixed displacement as dilation approaches the identity. No exact finite-dilation operator norm, full singular spectrum, or sharp trace norm is claimed. Historical priority in coherent-state calculus needs specialist verification.
title: A universal stable-rank law for Fock heat–Weyl commutators
